risks.title: Regulatory changes affecting demand
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first and repeated multiple times in the 10-K, with strong language (materially negative, adverse material effect). It relates to sensitive services such as regulatory communications and report distribution. The Regulation category is highly weighted in the financial sector.

risks.title: Cyberattacks or data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed across several paragraphs, with mention of past incidents (phishing, DoS) and critical exposure to sensitive data. The language is alarming (data exfiltration, ransomware, compromised reputation). Severity is exacerbated by reliance on third parties.

risks.title: Dependence on a few large clients
risks.score_rationale: One customer represents 7% of revenue, and the text highlights the material impact of losing a major client. The risk is compounded by customer investment costs (10% of assets). Centrally positioned in the 10-K, language is concerned but not alarmist.

risks.title: Concentration of third-party vendors
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions dependence on sole or limited suppliers, with risk of service disruption. Language is strong (material adverse effect), but less central than regulatory or cyber risks. Trend toward increasing regulatory requirements on vendor management.

risks.title: Decline in financial market activity
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly linked to transactional revenues and market activity. Mentions difficulties in forecasting and impact on event-based fees. Mid-level prominence in the document, language is measured but concerning.

risks.title: Non-compliance with data privacy laws
risks.score_rationale: The text cites GDPR, HIPAA, CPRA, GLBA, PCI DSS, indicating broad regulatory exposure. Risk of significant penalties. Language is preventive but serious, with mention of rising compliance costs.

risks.title: Consolidation in financial services
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly articulated with concrete examples of past mergers. Direct impact on client count and risk of service internalization. Language is concerned, but no indication of worsening trend versus prior year.

ai_positioning.summary: There is no significant mention of artificial intelligence in the provided text.
